explanation: App.tsx groups each explorer breadcrumb separator with the crumb after it (a site-crumb-trail span), so a wrapped breadcrumb never leaves a slash at the end of a line; routing, the dataset picker and the crumb text are unchanged. main.tsx bootstrap (registerUpdates, startVersionWatch) is untouched. The population crumb also carries its full text as a title, for when the wide-screen header truncates it.
